Get the prescribed application format from the website, or use the format printed in the notice.

Fill in the details the form asks for: post name, name in capital letters, father's name, age and date of birth as on the date of the advertisement, date of retirement and age at retirement, residential and communication addresses, phone, e-mail ID, sex, education, and details of employment in chronological order and of present employment where applicable.
Paste a passport size photo on the form, sign the declaration with place and date, and attach the documents chronologically as listed below.
Submit the form with self-attested photocopies of all the requisite documents to: Office of the Director, Regional Leprosy Training & Research Institute (RLTRI), Gouripur, Bankura, PIN-722132.

The notice does not say whether the application is to be sent by post or handed in. Originals of the certificates are to be brought for scrutiny at the interview.
important_instructions: The engagement is subject to a medical fitness certificate from the competent authority. The candidate must be physically and medically fit. On appointment, the doctor must take an oath of allegiance to the Constitution of India or make a solemn affirmation in the prescribed Proforma. The doctor shall not accept any other appointment or assignment, paid, part time or otherwise, nor engage in any kind of practice during the contract. The appointment carries the liability to serve anywhere under the administrative control of the Director, RLTRI, Gouripur, Bankura-722132. The engaged doctor has no claim or right for regular appointment to any post under Central Health Services. The Government reserves the right to discontinue or terminate the contractual doctor on failure to perform duties to the satisfaction of the competent authority, or abruptly without assigning any reason at any point of time. A false declaration or wilful suppression of material information makes the doctor liable for removal and other action the government may deem necessary. The competent authority reserves the right to cancel or vary the vacancies without assigning the reason.

content_sections.heading: About RLTRI
content_sections.text: The Regional Leprosy Training and Research Institute is an institute under the Directorate General of Health Services, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India. It is located at P.O.-Gouripur, Distt-Bankura, W.B.-722132. The selected doctors will work at RLTRI under the administrative control of its Director.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice prints a single post and does not name a department. The 3 vacancies are for GDMO and are against vacant posts at RLTRI.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Other eligibility rules in the notice: Age: not exceeding 69 years as on 01/01/2027. The notice prints no age relaxation. The candidate must be a citizen of India. The candidate must be retired from Central Govt./State Govt./PSU and must be a pensioner drawing pension from any of these bodies. Doctors who are retiring from Central/State government or public sector service within 06 months can also apply through proper channel. Knowledge of computers is desirable. The notice prints no work experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.qualification: Minimum qualification required is MBBS (the terms and conditions say MBBS Degree). The application form lists an MBBS degree recognized by Government or Equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The terms and conditions describe the Central Govt. rate as "Last Pay drawn at the time of Retirement minus Basic Pension". The remuneration will commence from the date of joining duty at the place of posting. The appointment is purely on contract basis, initially for one year (extendable if required) or till a regular incumbent joins, or till the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier. Extension of the contract is subject to the performance report by the controlling officer and regular attendance. The doctor is not entitled to provident fund, pension, gratuity, medical attendance treatment, seniority, promotion or any other benefit of a regular Government servant. Dearness Allowance and other allowances like HRA and TA, and benefits like LTC and leave encashment, are not admissible at any point of time. No non-practicing allowance is admissible in addition to the monthly fixed remuneration, and private practice of any kind is not permitted. The doctor is entitled to leave as per rules, but permission is not granted for more than 07 days at a stretch. The doctor is not entitled to any TA for expenditure on application, interview, joining or any other purpose during the serving period.

rows.remuneration: Consolidated amount of Rs.75,000/- per month, as per MoHFW Order F.No.A-11011/24/2025-Lep dated 06/10/2026
Pay drawn at the time of retirement minus basic pension, fixed as per MoH&FW Order No.A.12026/01/2022-CHS.I dated 14/07/2023 and Ministry of Finance OM No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09/12/2020

content_sections.heading: RLTRI General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) Job Description
content_sections.text: The primary duty is as a clinician. The engaged doctor shall also perform the duties assigned by the head of the office / controlling officer. The competent authority reserves the right to assign any duty as and when required, and no extra or additional allowance is admissible for such assignment. The doctor functions under the administrative control of the Director, RLTRI, Gouripur, Bankura.

The notice does not say whether the application is to be sent by post or handed in. The interview will be held in the Office of the Director, RLTRI, Gouripur, Bankura – 722132, and the date and time will be informed later to eligible candidates only. Originals of the certificates are to be brought for scrutiny at the interview.

content_sections.text: Matriculation Certificate / admit card as proof of age MBBS degree recognized by Government or Equivalent Registration Certificate Any one of Election ID Card, Driving License or Bank Passbook as proof of residence P.P.O. On appointment, the doctor must take an oath of allegiance to the Constitution of India or make a solemn affirmation in the prescribed Proforma. The doctor shall not accept any other appointment or assignment, paid, part time or otherwise, nor engage in any kind of practice during the contract. The appointment carries the liability to serve anywhere under the administrative control of the Director, RLTRI, Gouripur, Bankura-722132. The engaged doctor has no claim or right for regular appointment to any post under Central Health Services. The Government reserves the right to discontinue or terminate the contractual doctor on failure to perform duties to the satisfaction of the competent authority, or abruptly without assigning any reason at any point of time. The competent authority reserves the right to cancel or vary the vacancies without assigning the reason.

faq.question: Q1. How many GDMO vacancies are there in RLTRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice announces 3 General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) posts at RLTRI, Gouripur, Bankura, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for RLTRI GDMO?
faq.answer: The last date of submission is 15/12/2026 (15 December 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for RLTRI GDMO?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is MBBS. The candidate must also be a retired or retiring doctor who is a pensioner of Central Govt./State Govt./PSU.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for RLTRI GDMO?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 69 years as on 01/01/2027. The notice prints no age relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of RLTRI GDMO?
faq.answer: Doctors retired from State Govt./PSU get a consolidated Rs.75,000/- per month. For those retired from CHS, it is the pay drawn at the time of retirement minus basic pension.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for RLTRI GDMO?
faq.answer: Apply in the prescribed application format and submit it with self-attested photocopies of the requisite documents to the Office of the Director, RLTRI, Gouripur, Bankura, PIN-722132, by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for RLTRI GDMO?
faq.answer: The list of short-listed candidates and the date of interview will be intimated through e-mail/speed post. Eligible candidates are informed via e-mail at least 48 hours before the interview at the Director's office.

faq.question: Q8. Is the RLTRI GDMO job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a purely temporary contractual post, initially for one year, extendable if required, or till regular incumbents join or the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier. The doctor has no claim to regular appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Can doctors who are about to retire apply for RLTRI GDMO?
faq.answer: Yes, doctors retiring from Central/State government or public sector service within 06 months can also apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q10. Are HRA or TA paid on top of the RLTRI GDMO remuneration?
faq.answer: No. DA, HRA, TA and other allowances, LTC and leave encashment are not admissible, and no TA is paid for the interview or joining.
